articles.title: Civilians in Ukraine's Kherson prepare for the return of war as localized ceasefire ends
articles.description: Civilians in Ukraine's Kherson region prepare for the end of a localized ceasefire. The truce, brokered with help from U.S. first lady Melania Trump, allowed evacuations in Oleshky. It ends Sunday evening. About 2,000 civilians were in Oleshky when the truce began. They could evacuate to Ukrainian or Russian-controlled areas, or stay with replenished supplies. Meanwhile, Russian and Ukrainian drone attacks continue. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Russia targets Ukraine's energy systems, leaving many without power. In Kherson, the local theater continues performances, offering hope and unity.

articles.title: G20 foreign ministers end Atlanta meeting without consensus on key issue, group photo cancelled
articles.description: Top diplomats from the G20 met in Atlanta, but they could not agree on important global security issues. Tensions, particularly regarding Russia's war in Ukraine, overshadowed the talks and affected the outcomes. The meeting concluded without a joint communique, only a chairman's statement summarizing their discussions. Despite the lack of consensus, efforts were made to strengthen cooperation on supply chains and mineral resources.
